scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The Agent Reading Pipeline section states 'Soft 404 - Pass · 7/7' with the note 'Missing pages return a proper HTTP 404 status. No pages misleadingly return 200 for non-existent URLs,' yet the Discovery Files section and Error Page Test both document that the site returns HTTP 200 (soft 404) for non-existent paths including /zebedee.html and 41 well-known paths. The pipeline pass verdict contradicts evidence elsewhere in the same report.
findings.context:
Soft 404 - Pass · 7/7
  - *Means:* Missing pages return a proper HTTP 404 status. No pages misleadingly return 200

findings.message: The llms-full.txt finding hedges a straightforward absence ('Whether adding one would deliver meaningful value depends on the depth of dotfusion.com's full content catalogue') despite the finding being a simple presence/absence check on a discovery artefact, and the same item is listed as a High-priority gap in the Findings table and recommended without hedging in Priority 6; the inconsistent confidence level between sections is misleading.
findings.context: Whether adding one would deliver meaningful value depends on the depth of dotfusion.com's full content catalogue, which our audited sample of 7 pages does not yet measure
